name: Performance Check
description: Gate checker. Decides whether this project has a performance check of its own - a benchmark suite, a bundle-size budget, a Lighthouse or load script with a declared threshold - and names the command that runs it. Atlas runs it and routes on the exit code. Atlas ships no latency budget of its own, so a project without one is told plainly that nothing was checked.
summary: Finds this project's own benchmark or budget check, or says it has none.
